notes: The Recreation and Park Commission's 1952 volume. Curated: the official list of 1951 dedications, the architect contracts let in September 1952 for the next round of 1947 bond projects, field-house contracts, namings (Japanese Tea Garden, Frank Marini Memorial), memorials and master plans. Dates come from the volume's card index and page footers, because the meeting headings are often unreadable.

coverage.remaining: Routine items (payments, extensions, concessions, Camp Mather, the zoo) not curated. Not placed: the Aquatic Park swimming pool architects (Res. 896, no page), the Visitacion Valley Playground field house contract (Res. 903, Hart & Hynding, $53,239; no page), the Sutro Heights master plan by Kenneth F. Jones (Res. 737, no page) and the M. T. Beardslee Memorial Gateway at Sixth Avenue and Fulton (Res. 867, no page).
coverage.note: Index entries and footers read with /tmp ctx scripts; curated list F1952.py.
